last_completed: Attention Inbox is integrated and reuses buildBusinessAutomationSignals rather than adding a parallel event store.
Universal safe recovery/retry PR #359 is integrated: safe retries are limited to reads/idempotent operations, while uncertain non-idempotent writes refresh authoritative state first.

Operator Health PR #362 is integrated as a sanitized tenant-safe aggregation layer for services, jobs, integrations and data checks without exposing raw logs, provider payloads, credentials or secrets.

Re-audited current notification infrastructure before implementation: Activity Center and Attention Inbox already provide internal evidence; platform_audit_log already provides immutable audit storage; user_push_devices is only a mobile device registry and its canonical DB constraint supports ios/android only; the only email delivery is the project-request-specific Resend path; no generic push sender or generic email channel exists.

Notification Preferences + Channel Controls PR #368 was integrated into main after Architecture Guard, Quality Gate and ORBYVEN CI passed on head 169b9e3548d5bb672346bfa6ba3fefc137f82ea4 and the branch was verified 1 commit ahead / 0 commits behind main immediately before merge.

Added user_notification_preferences as a minimal per-user + per-organization push-only control plane with strict authenticated RLS ownership plus active organization membership checks. Unknown channels are rejected and a missing preference fails closed as push disabled.

Push device registration remains separate from delivery consent: successful ios/android device registration activates the push preference, while missing permission/device/token remains non-fatal to workspace activity flows. Disabling push does not delete the device registry and does not suppress Activity Center or Attention Inbox evidence.

Activity Center now exposes a minimalist push on/off control only when the native bridge is available. Preference reads/UI events return only channel/enabled/timestamp state and never expo_push_token, provider payloads, credentials or secrets.

Preference changes reuse the existing platform_audit_log through a private security-definer trigger. Audit metadata is bounded to channel and enabled; no separate audit storage or authenticated audit writer was introduced.

Targeted notification preference contract tests and security/RLS tests are registered in the existing ecosystem/security suites and passed together with lint, typecheck, architecture, security regressions and production build.

Post-merge audit identified Operator Health → Control Center presentation as the next plausible atomic milestone, but PR #350 is currently open, draft and non-mergeable and changes the same privileged Control Center routes/components/navigation. No competing wiring branch was created.
